name: Rowbly Stats
description:
Add a stats page per board. This page should show the following:

- Cards created
- Cards moved to done
- PR's created
- Commits created.

comments.body: Review of https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/157 at 6260eaca0548025fe2801752d110d3303e6b644b by codex/gpt-6-astra: CHANGES REQUESTED. 1. [P2] src/plugins/github/stats.ts:120-144: a pagination identity/head/count mismatch clears only that candidate, retaining its earlier identity/head/count. Another completed alias with those earlier values can then make the whole PR contribution complete. A deterministic mocked-source reproduction returned commits={status:complete,value:2} after a later page explicitly reported a changed head and totalCount=1. Preserve observed inconsistency at PR identity/group level and exclude that PR from commit contributions through every alias; return partial/unavailable with the reason. Extend the existing collector contract check for this alias-plus-pagination race. 2. [P2] src/services/boardStats.ts:90-96: collection iterates the raw registry and calls stats.metrics.map even for declarations rejected by loading. With boardStats.metrics=null, loadPlugins correctly marks the Plugin failed, but boards.stats throws TypeError instead of returning core and healthy Plugin metrics. Validate or sanitize metric declarations before rendering, including Off/failed Plugins, and extend the existing loading/collection check to prove malformed declarations cannot crash Stats. Reviewed the full diff, accepted current-record scope, bounded reads, frozen snapshots, capability boundaries, CLI/TUI wiring, docs/ADR0054 and preserved ROW73 integration. Independent validation on the clean local merge of current main: typecheck PASS; lint PASS; unit 79 PASS; CLI 21 PASS. All six current-head CI checks passed, none pending. Reproduction scripts: /tmp/row-70-review-astra-1-repro.mts and /tmp/row-70-review-astra-1-repro-changed-count.mts. No product changes made.
